headline: Web platforms make multi-modal genomic and expression data interactively explorable
label: Interactive Omics Visualization Platforms
summary: Harmonized GWAS, QTL, and GTEx expression resources are now queryable in browsers without coding.
synthesis: The common thread is interactive access to curated biological data rather than new biological findings. COLSTATS wraps 1.65M harmonized GWAS and QTL summary statistics (hg38) in a Shiny platform that runs coloc.abf colocalization interactively. Age effect explorer provides code-free browsing of age- and sex-associated expression across 54 GTEx v10 tissues, using precomputed linear-model results. MetaTree anchors hierarchical profiles to a shared reference tree for multi-group comparison, and RingNet offers an R-backed web tool for multi-modal network visualization with node and edge filtering and SVG/PNG export. The thread is dominated by visualization and access tooling. RingNet and MetaTree are general visualization frameworks, so database-style harmonization applies most clearly to COLSTATS and the GTEx resource. What distinguishes this set is browser-based interaction layered over precomputed, harmonized statistics, with COLSTATS reaching 1.65M summary statistics as the largest collection described here.
